related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」與「真空抽氣與壁處理」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" and "Vacuum pumping and wall conditioning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦兩層真空邊界：雙層壁真空室、世界最大的不鏽鋼真空容器、熱屏蔽與烘烤；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on two vacuum boundaries: the double-walled vacuum vessel, the world's largest stainless vacuum chamber, thermal shields and baking; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「中子壁負載」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Neutron wall loading" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」與「真空抽氣與壁處理」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" and "Vacuum pumping and wall conditioning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

related.title: ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管
related.titleEn: ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid
related.transfer: 可遷移「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」與「真空抽氣與壁處理」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" and "Vacuum pumping and wall conditioning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦兩層真空邊界：雙層壁真空室、世界最大的不鏽鋼真空容器、熱屏蔽與烘烤；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管則以史上最大的超導磁體系統：環向場線圈匝數、鈮三錫線材、中央螺管伏秒與現場繞製的極向場線圈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on two vacuum boundaries: the double-walled vacuum vessel, the world's largest stainless vacuum chamber, thermal shields and baking; ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid centres on the largest superconducting magnet system ever built: toroidal field turns, niobium-tin strand, central solenoid volt-seconds and poloidal field coils wound on site, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「磁壓與比壓」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「中子壁負載」的模型移到ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「高溫超導電流引線」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Magnetic pressure and beta".
Move the model of "Neutron wall loading" to ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "High-temperature superconducting current leads", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」與「真空抽氣與壁處理」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" and "Vacuum pumping and wall conditioning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器
history.text: 2015 年恆溫器組件開始運抵工地；2020 年恆溫器底座吊入托卡馬克坑；2021 年首個真空室扇段模組吊入；2022 年發現扇段尺寸偏差與熱屏蔽管路裂紋，啟動修復。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2015: Cryostat sections began arriving on site. 2020: The cryostat base was lowered into the tokamak pit. 2021: The first vacuum-vessel sector module was lowered in. 2022: Sector deviations and thermal-shield pipe cracks were found and repair began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
